module PivotMod
{
    /* Faster turner. Ported from the B41 NATS / On Your Toes mods to the B42
       script-defined trait system. The trait TYPES are registered in
       media/registries.lua; these blocks add their UI/cost/XP definitions.
       Baseline +1 / -1 Nimble. The traits only overhaul pivoting when the mod's
       "Restrict to trait holders only" / "Use Nimble-based turning" sandbox
       options are on; otherwise turning is global and the trait is just a Nimble
       add-on. */
    character_trait_definition pivotmod:onyourtoes
    {
        IsProfessionTrait = false,
        DisabledInMultiplayer = false,
        CharacterTrait = pivotmod:onyourtoes,
        Cost = 4,
        UIName = UI_trait_OnYourToes,
        UIDescription = UI_trait_OnYourToesdesc,
        XPBoosts = Nimble=1,
        MutuallyExclusiveTraits = pivotmod:podshofe,
    }

    character_trait_definition pivotmod:podshofe
    {
        IsProfessionTrait = false,
        DisabledInMultiplayer = false,
        CharacterTrait = pivotmod:podshofe,
        Cost = -3,
        UIName = UI_trait_PodShofe,
        UIDescription = UI_trait_PodShofedesc,
        XPBoosts = Nimble=-1,
        MutuallyExclusiveTraits = pivotmod:onyourtoes,
    }
}
